created_from: Owner-reported editorial usefulness concern supported by sealed bundle metadata; no independent claim of watching both full programs.

incidents.impact: Both videos were selected from the same original company and are first-party Workday product-configuration lessons rather than source-diverse independent AI instruction.
incidents.issue: The same-publisher exception and medium-promotion risk classification allowed two product-specific 13.7/16.8-minute lessons. Signed-out playback and source-transcript review did not ensure independently useful, unbiased educational variety.
incidents.resolution: Owner-requested media-only correction published to the October 29 reader: replaced both Workday product-configuration videos with PBS NewsHour 'AI agents going rogue fuel calls for regulation' (6:30) and TED 'AI brain fry is real. Here's what leaders can do' (9:06). Protected PR #290 merged; existing Pages correction workflow verified both actual signed-out full-length duration-matched players advancing, all 11 changed live reader/feed/archive/feedback surfaces byte-for-byte, and persisted corrected cumulative Pages history. Original six accepted PNGs, immutable Oct29 editorial bundle, podcasts, articles, earlier editions, IDs and schedules were unchanged.
incidents.playback_evidence_limit: Actual signed-out duration-matched players advanced during prepublish and release checks; full episodes were not watched end-to-end and no guarantee is made against future provider changes.
incidents.prevention: Prospective October 30+ two-original-publisher rule and no two-medium-risk-video pair, plus source review in the existing Compiler task.
